scripts.build: npm run catalogue; npm run content; npm run qr-map; tsc --noEmit && vite build && cp dist/index.html dist/404.html && node scripts/prerender-works.mjs
scripts.catalogue: node scripts/snapshot-catalogue.mjs || echo 'Catalogue snapshot skipped: building with the committed src/data/artworks.json'
scripts.content: node scripts/snapshot-site-content.mjs || echo 'Site content snapshot skipped: building with the committed src/data/site-content.json'
scripts.qr-map: node scripts/qr-map.mjs || echo 'QR map refresh skipped: keeping the committed api/_qr-map.js'
